titulo.estudio: Un récit à remettre en ordre : Lire l'ensemble
titulo.alumno: A story to put in order: Integrated reading

intro: Rebuild the sequence of a story and tell apart the cause, the discovery and the result. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Key words: a story to put in order
Un récit à remettre en ordre

frases.estudio: Alors que nous rentrions du marché, une pluie soudaine nous a obligés à chercher un abri.
frases.alumno: As we were coming back from the market, a sudden downpour forced us to look for shelter.

frases.estudio: Nous sommes entrés dans une vieille librairie qui se trouvait au coin de la rue.
frases.alumno: We went into an old bookshop that was on the corner of the street.

frases.estudio: Pendant que nous attendions, la libraire a reconnu le sac que j'avais perdu la veille.
frases.alumno: While we were waiting, the bookseller recognised the bag that I had lost the day before.

frases.estudio: Finalement, nous sommes rentrés avec le sac et un roman recommandé par la libraire.
frases.alumno: In the end, we went home with the bag and a novel that the bookseller recommended.

texto: Rebuild the sequence of a story and tell apart the cause, the discovery and the result. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: « Dès que », « pendant que » and « finalement » express time relations; relative pronouns pick up earlier elements. In this passage, «pendant» means «during».
